name: Reijou Trader ~Koukan Torihiki~
original_name: 令嬢トレーダー ～交換取引～
source:
Japan's top company is rumored to face bankruptcy soon. Director's daughter is approached by a man with an article that can bring doom upon the company. Innocent girl is violated and polluted as a tool in exchange for the article.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
